# Respawn

Keeps the respawn timer at its configured length. Monolith#4813 scales it by the game preset in the CVar setters,
but with no preset set (server start, a round without one) the timer stays at zero. The setters in
`Content.Server/_Corvax/Respawn/RespawnSystem.cs` fall back to the configured value; `RespawnTimerTest` covers it.
